title_en: A Bowl of Porridge Two Thousand Kilometers Away
note_en: 孝顺 means "devoted and caring toward one's parents" — not just "polite," but a whole set of duties children owe their elders. In the text: 他总觉得自己不够孝顺 "he always felt he wasn't a good enough son"; 孝顺不是一个月寄多少钱 "being a good son isn't about how much money you send each month." English has no single word: "filial," "devoted to one's parents," "a good son or daughter."
